{{Quote|Instead of comforting one poor clone, we should be out ''there'', taking the fight to those animals that forced us to build places like this!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]|<ref name="A Trooper's Tale">{{TCWComicCite|6.8|A Trooper's Tale}}</ref>}}
A '''clone medical and rehabilitation facility''' was established on the planet [[Sacorria]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone trooper sergeant]] [[Marrt]] underwent treatment there following his [[Mission to Belgaroth|mission]] to [[Belgaroth]].
